description: Public-domain scanned prints for qualifying the photo repair and colourise workloads (FL-933). Links, hashes and licence basis only: no image is kept in this repository. Each file was fetched once from The Met's open-access collection, decoded, and accepted by eye as a photograph of people that fills the frame. A qualification run reads them from the private package below.
